about: Reanimated with the session's Reduce Motion (docs/adr/0019-settings.mdx), changed while the application runs (sample/ReducedMotionProbe.tsx). With it on from the start, Reanimated's useReducedMotion() is true and a 3 s withTiming with ReduceMotion.System (Reanimated's default) jumps to its end at once, as on Android. Turned off from the application (granted `settings`, as the session grants Settings), the session tells every application: useReducedMotion() renders false at once and the next animation takes its 3 s; turned on again, true again and the next animation ends at once. With the host telling Reanimated reduce motion is off, the first animation takes its duration and it fails; with Reanimated reading the setting only at start, the hook stays on and the second animation still ends at once, and it fails.

steps.name: Reduce Motion on from the start: useReducedMotion() is true, and Animate's 3 s animation ends at once at its end
Toggle: the session turns Reduce Motion off and tells the application; useReducedMotion() renders false
Animate with Reduce Motion off: the box moves back over its 3 s
Toggle: Reduce Motion on again; useReducedMotion() renders true
Animate with Reduce Motion on again: it ends at once at its end
